title: Evaluating AI Recruitment Sourcing Tools by Human Preference

live_model.evidence: "The OpenAI model (o3-mini-2025-01-31) produced the binary preference in the profile idx field" (Sec. 5.1); "LLM-judge labels: Evaluations produced by an automated LLM (o3-mini-2025-01-31)" (Sec. 5.3)

prompt.note: This is the judge prompt (compares two candidate profiles); there is no subject-model prompt since o3-mini is not the system under test.

claim.metric: none for o3-mini as subject (the paper's claims are about sourcing-tool relevance/Elo ratings, using o3-mini only as the comparator)

notes: o3-mini-2025-01-31 is used solely as an LLM-judge comparing candidate-profile pairs to benchmark third-party recruitment sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, JuiceBox, Exa.ai, Pearch.ai); the paper's headline Elo/win-rate results belong to those tools, not to o3-mini's own generative performance. The paper does report LLM-judge vs. human-majority alignment (Sec. 5.3) but does not give a single extracted numeric value for it in the reviewed text.
